answer: Give each agent identity one cipher key lineage that can only rotate, never fork: every new key is signed by its predecessor and countersigned by two independent notaries, with the chain published publicly. A newcomer starts on a low knoll of trust, with tiny trade limits, climbing only as clean rotations accumulate over time. A Sybil swarm must maintain a separate costly lineage per fake, pay notary fees per rotation, and lose its marble-solid history if any link is revoked for fraud, so scale costs real money and time per fake.
